question: In February 2022, who launched the ICMR DHR Policy on Biomedical Innovation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mansukh Mandaviya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Mansukh Mandaviya is the Union Minister for Health and Family Welfare in India.
 
• In February 2022, Mansukh Mandaviya launched the ICMR DHR Policy on Biomedical Innovation to promote research and development in the field of biomedical sciences.
 
• The policy aims to encourage innovation and translation of biomedical research into practical applications for healthcare improvement.
 
• The Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) and Department of Health Research (DHR) collaborated on this** initiative to boost India's healthcare ecosystem**.
 
• This policy is aligned with the government’s vision to strengthen the healthcare sector and achieve self-reliance in medical innovations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR):**

 
 
• ICMR is one of the oldest medical research institutions in the world, established in 1911.
 
• It works under the Department of Health Research, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India.
 
• Its primary focus is on advancing medical research and providing evidence-based solutions to health challenges in India.
 
 
 
• **Department of Health Research (DHR):**
 
 
• DHR was established in 2007 under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.
 
• Its mandate includes promoting and coordinating biomedical research in India.
 
• DHR provides funding and support for innovative healthcare projects and policies.
